intro: The status badges describe commands in ImagePlayground 3.3.0. The ChartForgeX notes identify features already available through the native .NET libraries and link to their documentation. A partial or planned command does not mean the rendering engine lacks that feature.

tracking.title: Request a command or vote on the roadmap

rows.capability: Thirty chart kinds as commands: line, area, stacked and step area, bar, horizontal bar, scatter, bubble, lollipop, range, box plot, histogram, heatmap, pie, donut, radial, gauge, progress, pictorial, bullet, funnel, treemap, waterfall, radar, polar, slope and word cloud
Legend, data labels, palette, grid, axis titles, transparent backgrounds and donut centre text
Reference lines and point callouts
Chart titles, subtitles and category labels
Sankey, sunburst, chord, Gantt, timeline, candlestick and calendar heatmap
rows.note: No dedicated commands yet. The ChartForgeX methods (AddSankey, AddSunburst, AddGanttTask and others) are reachable from -ChartScript.

native.summary: Available through the native chart APIs, including dated Gantt and timeline observations.

rows.capability: Dotted, region and tile maps
rows.note: Reachable from -ChartScript with AddDottedMap, AddRegionMap and AddTileMap; no map commands yet.

native.summary: Available through AddDottedMap, AddRegionMap and AddTileMap, with independent weight and color values.

rows.capability: Bar, line, area, scatter and range series combined in one chart, with per-series markers and a secondary axis
Graphite themes and custom design tokens
rows.note: -Theme offers fourteen named themes. Custom VisualTheme configuration and palette imports need the .NET API.

native.summary: Available through immutable VisualTheme palettes, typography and geometry. Configure creates an independent theme.

rows.capability: Service maps with kinds, statuses, groups, ports, node details and edge labels
Manual, grouped, hub, force-directed, radial, mind-map and geographic layouts
Automatic layered layout for branching graphs, with -Layer to pin a column
Organization charts from manager links
Scenarios and route motion as animated SVG or GIF
Interactive HTML with pan, zoom and node details
Layout diagnostics and collision checks
Custom and vendor icon-pack loading
rows.note: Nodes accept -IconId, but no command loads a ChartForgeX icon pack yet.

native.summary: Available through catalog and manifest loaders. Curated packs, imported Azure artwork and Veeam/Fortinet samples have their own provenance and licenses; complete vendor catalogs are not all built in.

rows.capability: Graph explorer for large graphs (Canvas and WebGL)
rows.note: Graph explorer commands are not part of ImagePlayground.

native.summary: Available in ChartForgeX.Interactivity.Html with SVG, Canvas and WebGL backends, hierarchy and bounded graph updates.

rows.capability: Dashboards of metric cards, tables, lists, timelines and charts
Table blocks from pipeline objects, with calculated columns, formats and alignment
Social preview cards and desktop wallpapers
Watermarks on charts, maps and exported artifacts
Visual artifacts with accessible names and descriptions, including whole dashboards
Animated terminal sessions as SVG, HTML, GIF or APNG
rows.note: A .png path writes the final frame; use .apng for animation.

rows.capability: Source-to-result stories with code and media panels
Motion cues on dashboards
PNG, SVG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF and static HTML, chosen by file extension
WebP output
rows.note: ImagePlayground writes WebP files, but its current encoder barely compresses them; prefer PNG until that encoder is fixed.

native.summary: Provides PNG, SVG and RGBA output. WebP encoding belongs to the receiving image adapter, rather than the ChartForgeX renderer.

rows.capability: Interactive chart HTML: tooltips, selection, zoom and brushing
rows.note: ImagePlayground chart HTML is static and script-free. Only topology has -InteractiveHtml.

native.summary: Available through the optional ChartForgeX.Interactivity.Html adapter; core chart HTML stays static and script-free.

rows.capability: Mermaid diagrams rendered by ChartForgeX.Mermaid
rows.note: ChartForgeX.Mermaid is not part of the module yet.

native.summary: Available through ChartForgeX.Mermaid for the documented notation subsets, with native SVG and PNG output.

rows.capability: ChartForgeX Markup fences: charts and diagrams from Markdown
rows.note: ChartForgeX.Markup is not part of the module yet.

native.summary: Available through ChartForgeX.Markup parsers, diagnostics and native visual artifacts.
